levels.note: People pool with summary seasons; schools are produced by world generation (G-81), not shipped here.

assumptions.secondSubdivisionConferenceSizes: T2.1 gives 128 teams in 13 conferences but no per-conference sizes; sizes 12,12,11,11,10,10,10,10,9,9,8,8,8 are an assumption.
assumptions.density: Regional school counts follow each region's share of 2025 college-roster home-state players (data/people/college_roster_seasons_2010_2026.csv). Conferences are fixed regional clusters, so the match is approximate; see densityCheck.
